records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate with water to the desired working dilution. ADOX documents dilutions from 1+25 to 1+500.
records.reuseInstructions: Use once and discard; ADOX states Rodinal cannot be reused.
records.capacityText: Use at least 5 ml concentrate per 135 or 120 film; minimum concentrate quantity governs capacity.

records.preparation: Standard one-shot dilution is 1+9. Higher dilutions such as 1+14 and 1+19 are documented for stronger compensation.
records.reuseInstructions: Prepared working solutions are discarded after use.
records.capacityText: At 1+9: 100 ml concentrate develops up to 4 films in 250 ml Jobo tank volumes; 500 ml develops up to 20 films.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Partly opened concentrate protected from air with gas, squeezed bottle or glass marbles keeps at least a further 6 months, depending on fill level.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Prepared working solution is one-shot and should be discarded after use.

records.preparation: Dissolve the powder parts successively in warm water, allowing each part to dissolve completely, then allow the stock solution to cool for several hours.
records.reuseInstructions: Use 1+1 as one-shot, or reuse stock solution. One litre stock can process up to 10 films; after the fifth film add one minute for every additional film.
records.capacityText: 1 litre package: 10 films; 5 litre package: 50 films.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Unopened powder bags: at least 3 years.
records.shelfLifeStock: Prepared stock stored in dark, completely filled glass bottles with protective gas or displacement: at least 6 weeks.
records.storageNotes: Store dry and dark at 10-25 C; minimize air in stock bottles.

records.preparation: Standard dilution is 1+29; for example 10 ml concentrate plus 290 ml water makes 300 ml working solution.
records.reuseInstructions: Use the 1+29 working solution once and discard.
records.capacityText: 100 ml concentrate makes 3 litres and processes up to 12 rolls; 250 ml makes 7.5 litres and processes up to 30 rolls, based on 250 ml per film in a Jobo tank.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Unopened concentrate: 1-2 years when stored cool, dry and dark.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution: about 1 hour; discard after use.

records.preparation: Prepare stock solution by dissolving Part A in about three quarters of the final water volume at about 40 C, then Part B, then make up to final volume and cool to about 20 C.
records.reuseInstructions: Stock may be reused with time compensation. Dilutions 1+1 and 1+3 should not be reused.
records.capacityText: Stock solution: 10 rolls of 135-36 or 120 per litre when reused with time compensation.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Unopened powder stored cool and dry at 4-20 C keeps indefinitely.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Once a powder packet is opened, prepare the stock solution immediately.
records.shelfLifeStock: Stock: up to 6 months full capped; 1 month half full; 4 months in a deep tank with floating lid; 1 month without floating lid.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Diluted 1+1 or 1+3: no more than 24 hours.

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate to the selected working strength, commonly 1+9 or 1+14, immediately before use.
records.reuseInstructions: Mix for immediate use only and discard the working solution after processing.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Mix for immediate use only; do not store for reuse.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD Photochemistry FAQs - ILFOSOL 3 shelf life

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+4 with water for standard use.
First dilute the concentrate to make stock solution, then further dilute the stock for use. ILFORD documents working dilutions including 1+11, 1+15, 1+31, 1+47 and specialist dilutions.
records.reuseInstructions: ILFORD specifies that ILFOTEC HC developer should not be used as replenisher; use according to the selected process dilution.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD ILFOTEC HC Film Developer Technical Information
